messages:
sam_eng: deploy-bot reports traffic shift 60% -> 80% for text-generation v3. Canary window open.

deploy-bot: canary update: service=text-gen version=v3 traffic=80% commit=9f8a7b6 status=active

mina_qa: dashboards show p95 up from 180ms -> 420ms across the gen-route. error rate small uptick 0.04% -> 0.09% (mostly 503s).

ryan_oncall: seeing a cluster of 503s from the model-workers pool in eu-west-1. correlates with larger batch sizes and longer seq lengths.

sam_eng: is this selective? any difference by client or route?

devops_lee: quick split by header X-Client-Type: internal vs external. internal traffic p95 flat, external p95 degraded. External also has more requests with X-Seq-Len >= 800.

release_coordinator: release notes: v3 includes a new quant path that may change memory allocations. we should consider pinning critical clients to v2 until we rule out memory pressure.

mina_qa: can we do a scoped pin by client tag or header? routing-service supports header-based routing and a client-tag mapping.

sam_eng: propose: route X-Client-Type=external AND X-Seq-Len>=800 -> text-gen:v2. Keep everything else on v3. That mitigates tail latency for external long-context traffic without full rollback.

ryan_oncall: agree. also enable short-term autoscaling bump for model-workers in eu-west to reduce 503s while we observe.

deploy-bot: routing-change scheduled: add rule match=(X-Client-Type==external && X-Seq-Len>=800) -> backend=text-gen:v2 (dry-run)

devops_lee: dry-run ok, no config conflicts. ready to activate.

sam_eng: activate and set alerting: create alert if overall 5xx > 0.2% or p95 for seq<800 increases >25% from baseline.

deploy-bot: routing-change executed: rule active id=rt-2026-06-10-13

mina_qa: immediate effect: external long-context p95 fell from 620ms -> 310ms in 2m. overall p95 down to 240ms. 5xx rate trending down.

ryan_oncall: autoscaler bumped replica count +2 in eu-west-1. 503s decreased. i'll keep an eye on GC and OOM logs.

sam_eng: thanks. set a 30-minute soak and then reevaluate. If we see re-occurrence, prepare rollback to v2 with blue/green plan.

release_coordinator: created ticket REL-789 to capture workaround and follow-up RCA with infra & ML teams. Also note in release notes under Known Issues: observed high tail latency & transient 503s for external long-context requests; workaround via routing pin.

devops_lee: added trace links and heap/alloc graphs to REL-789. pointing ML to quantization integration tests.

mina_qa: leaving high-cadence sampling (30s) for the next 25m. will report back at +15m and +30m.

sam_eng: good. no full rollback for now. keep routing pin and autoscale bump. if alerts fire, we'll execute the rollback playbook.

deploy-bot: reminder: canary window scheduled to close at 1769006121. roll metrics snapshot will be attached to REL-789.

release_coordinator: summary: activated length-and-client-aware routing pin to v2, autoscale bump in eu-west, monitoring on high cadence, ticket REL-789 created for RCA and release-note update.

ryan_oncall: noted. tagging oncall rotation and paging policy. :thumbsup:

mina_qa: will post a +15m status update here.

sam_eng: thanks team — great quick coordination.
